description: Federal lobbying registrations and quarterly reports from LDA.gov, newest first. Each filing carries the client who paid, the lobbying firm, income or expenses, issue codes and specific issues lobbied, government bodies contacted, the individual lobbyists, and the filing link. Use it to see who is lobbying on a company's behalf or on an issue.

issue.description: Text search in specific issues, e.g. 'artificial intelligence'.

period.description: q1, q2, q3, q4, mid_year or year_end.

registrant.description: Lobbying firm or in-house filer name.

name: get_lobbying
title: Get federal lobbying disclosures (LDA.gov)
